newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador names new finance chief, other ministers.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador names new finance chief, other ministers.

text.p: New Ecuadorean President Fabian Alarcon said Thursday he named economist Carlos Davalos as finance minister and also announced his appointments to the defense and health portfolios.
Davalos is deputy director of the Frente Radical Alfarista party led by Alarcon.
Alarcon named General Ramiro Ricaute as defense minister and Eduardo Alcivar as health minister.
"Our cabinet is the product of dialogue and consensus," he said in a public ceremony.
On Tuesday, Congress appointed Alarcon president until August 1998, replacing Abdala Bucaram who was ousted by the legislature a week ago on grounds of "mental incompetence."
